title: The Self-Checkout — EN/ES/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish German life philosophy language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The self-checkout machine was designed by an optimist
Who thought we all wanted to become a checkout analyst
Unexpected item in the bagging area — I know
That item is my shopping and I put it there — let's go

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La caja automática no me quiere a mí
[The self-checkout machine doesn't like me]
Me pide código de barras que ya no está aquí
[It asks for a barcode that is no longer here]
Artículo inesperado — siempre el mismo error
[Unexpected item — always the same mistake]
Soy el cliente y también el cajero — qué horror
[I'm the customer and also the cashier — what horror]

[Chorus — English]
The self-checkout knows something I don't know
It knows that half of human dignity is putting on a show
The self-checkout has me scanning and guessing the weight of fruit
I'm the customer but I'm also the checkout — that's the absolute
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die Selbstbedienungskasse ist eine Prüfung
[The self-checkout is an examination]
Man bezahlt nicht nur — man besteht eine Übung
[You don't just pay — you pass a test]
Unerwarteter Artikel im Ablagbereich
[Unexpected item in the bagging area]
Das kenne ich gut — es wird immer das Gleiche
[I know that well — it's always the same thing]

[Outro — All three languages]
The self-checkout knows… La caja automática sabe… Die Selbstbedienungskasse weiß
Unexpected item — Artículo inesperado — Unerwarteter Artikel
That's my boy
